fields.statement: At 904ebb48 read the diff: daemon.Resumable (internal/daemon/pick.go) now skips a landed change set only when the run's workflow is not plan and its journal never entered land, so a plan run on a landed record resumes, while rejected/withdrawn/superseded/proposed/draft states still fall to default and are skipped. Ran go test -count=1 ./internal/daemon -run Resumable: TestResumableOnlyAcceptedOrLandedPastLand passes and returns exactly [run-accepted run-landed-past run-landed-plan], excluding withdrawn-plan, rejected-plan, superseded-plan and landed-never (a non-plan run on a landed change set that never reached land); TestResumable and TestResumableLeavesAStoreLockedRun pass. Ran the new testscript daemon-resume-landed-plan (fake rex): a landed plan run with a dead process is resumed by rhiza daemon --once, journals exactly one daemon-resumed entry and one detached run resume, and a second --once resumes nothing. All daemon* testscripts, including daemon-resume and daemon-resume-landed (accepted-only, once, landed-past-land), pass.
